title: tiktok
description: Scrapes videos from a public TikTok profile or hashtag. Needs an authenticated session, forwarded to the Worker as TIKTOK_SESSION. Comments and replies ARE collected when you ask for them, but not over the API: TikTok answers /api/comment/list with an empty 200 body (content-length: 0) in every automated browser environment measured, while serving the video feed from the same page and session normally - so comments are read from the rendered comment panel instead, and the fields below say what that costs. IMPORTANT: TikTok also fingerprints its data endpoints and returns EMPTY responses to automated browsers on datacenter IP addresses, regardless of session. A run from a hosted server may therefore return zero videos with no error; the log says which case it was ('item_list responses seen: 0' means TikTok served nothing, not that the scrape broke).

target.description: A profile ('nasa', '@nasa' or a tiktok.com/@... URL) or, in hashtag mode, a hashtag ('#space' or 'space').

mode.description: What the target names. Defaults to 'profile'. A hashtag feed is RANKED rather than chronological, so a date range over one filters what it is served rather than covering a period.

max_posts.description: Cap on posts returned. OMIT IT when using a date range on a profile: the range is then the stopping condition, and a count here would cut the window short.

start_date.description: Only posts at or after this moment (UTC, inclusive). A bare date means midnight.

end_date.description: Only posts at or before this moment (UTC, inclusive). A bare date means end of day.

collect_comments.title: Collect comments
collect_comments.description: Also collect each video's comments. Read from the RENDERED comment panel: TikTok answers /api/comment/list with an empty 200 to automated browsers, but still draws the comments, so they are read off the page. Author, text and reply threading are exact; timestamps are reconstructed from the panel's relative labels ("5d ago") and like counts are the rounded figures the site displays. Slower than the post scrape. On unless turned off.

max_comments_per_post.title: Comments per video
max_comments_per_post.description: Cap on TOP-LEVEL comments collected per video. Replies are extra and do not count toward it.

max_replies_per_comment.title: Replies per comment
max_replies_per_comment.description: Cap on replies collected for EACH comment that has any - not per video and not per run, because a single comment can carry thousands and the rest of the batch waits behind it. 0 collects no replies at all. Leave unset for the collector's default of 20. A comment nobody answered costs no requests either way.

analyse.description: Also produce an AI analysis and report (text, PDF and an HTML dashboard) alongside the data. Defaults to true. Costs two Claude calls; the scrape itself is unaffected either way.

ai_prompt.description: Your own analysis instructions, e.g. 'focus on complaints about delivery times'. Added to the built-in brief rather than replacing it, so the report keeps its structure and always renders.
